brief:
A San Francisco court issued 30-day jail sentences for seven pro-Palestine demonstrators, Shehab Wire reported. The convictions stemmed from their participation in a 2024 protest against Israeli military operations in Gaza. Court records did not specify the exact charges or the timing of the sentencing.

The case represents one of the first criminal convictions in the United States tied to pro-Palestine activism amid the current wave of demonstrations. The sentencing underscores heightened legal scrutiny of protest activities related to the Gaza conflict across American jurisdictions. The seven protesters had been part of larger demonstrations that swept U.S. cities during 2024.
